newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sydkraft in 5-yr supply deal with Stora.
newsitem.headline: Sydkraft in 5-yr supply deal with Stora.

text.p: Swedish power company Sydkraft said on Thursday it had signed a five year electricity supply deal with Stora Hylte and Stora Nymolla, two companies within forestry group Stora.
The agreement, that comes into effect on January 1 next year, amounts to about 1.5 TWh a year which is equivalent to about one percent of Sweden's total electricity use, Sydkraft said in a statement.
"Sydkraft will also work on ways to increase efficiency in the two companies in order to avoid costly stops in production," Sydkraft said.
